What is a Project Dashboard?

A project dashboard is a centralized platform that displays key performance indicators (KPIs), metrics, and data related to your mortgage brokering business. It helps you monitor progress, identify areas for improvement, and make data-driven decisions. With a project dashboard, you can track loan applications, client communication, and task assignments in one place.
